en: Shoes on! But wait... which foot goes in first? Do you know?
<SAW> taught us a lovely little sunnah.
When you put your shoes on, start with the right foot!
And when you take your shoes off, start with the left foot.
So the right foot goes in first, and comes out last!
Let's practise! Right shoe on, then the left. Left shoe off, then the right.
Can you do it today? Say: Right foot first!
